basic_profile.bio: A 17-year-old high school student from Austin, Texas. Passionate about video games and currently exploring modded Minecraft, specifically RLCraft. Enjoys action movies, with a particular fondness for the John Wick series. Recently got into ear stretching after seeing it on a friend's Instagram. Typically online during evenings and weekends. Works part-time at a local fast-food joint. Single and focused on school and hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Primarily self-taught in gaming and technology through YouTube tutorials and Reddit threads. Gained an interest in modding games and exploring new tech gadgets through online forums and communities.
